_what: Every narration sentence maps to a span of script/essay.txt, the sources of record for this film.
essay_version: film A draft 2 (the user's script, 2026-10-24), with four factual edits flagged in epoch_note/why
thesis: The marks of touch and time made every Cent different; the collectors catalogued those marks over two years of voting; and out of that catalogue the Sets were identified, each a structure whose limits are set by the rarest Cents it needs, open to anyone exploring the project on cents.vision.
script_target: 362 words measures 197 s at 1.84 w/s; spoken numbers run longer than their word count
epoch_convention: See essay block [7]. CATALOGUE = Sep 2026 export measured 2026-10-24; HOLDERS = 9 Sep 2026 snapshot, said with its date; SETS = cents.vision/sets.html.

claims.say: Let's explore CENTS Sets and the traits that constitute them.
Every difference to the canvas of the Lincoln cent is made by the marks of touch and time.
claims.why: User's line, verbatim. Replaces 'Circulation made the marks.'

claims.say: The cataloging of these marks is the result of two years of voting.
claims.span: a community-led initiative carried out over the course of 2 years through multiple reviews of the full 10k set, numerous voting rounds

claims.say: Out of this catalog, Sets were identified.
claims.span: emergent structures identified within the collection's internal dynamics

claims.say: Let's look at them in order of rarity.
claims.why: User's line, verbatim. FLAGGED: holds within the patina family (caps 598, 150, 69, 15, 9) but not across families; the Contamination Set has no hard cap. Awaiting the user's call.

claims.say: Verdigris, obsidian, desert and red are the base patinas: one notable trait from each base patina makes a Patina Set.
claims.span: at least one **Notable+** of each of the 4 base patinas
claims.epoch_note: User's line; quotation marks dropped for reading aloud (the card shows the terms). 'Notable' means notable or stronger.

claims.say: One significant trait from each base patina makes a Sig Set.
claims.span: at least one **Significant+** of all 4 base patinas

claims.say: Gold and orange are the noble patinas: a Patina Set that also includes a gold and an orange is a Spectrum Set.
claims.span: **Notable+** of all 4 base patinas *plus* Gold and Orange
claims.epoch_note: EDITED from the user's line: orange has a single level, so 'a notable trait from both the noble patinas' is not a level orange has.

claims.say: One full trait from each of the base patinas makes a Fulls Set.
claims.span: one **Full** of each of the 4 base patinas

claims.say: Only 15 can exist, as there are only 15 Full Verdigris Cents.
claims.epoch_note: User's line. A cap on complete Sets held at any one time.

claims.say: One full from each base patina, plus a full gold and an orange, makes a Full Spectrum Set.
claims.span: one **Full** of all 4 base patinas *plus* Full Gold and Orange
claims.epoch_note: EDITED: the user's 'one full from each base and noble patina' — orange has no full level.

claims.say: Only 9 such Sets can exist, as there are only 9 Full Gold Cents.

Contaminations are intricately cataloged, in 12 types: glue, scotch tape, 3D-black, alien secretion, paint, obscure adhesive, dark grime, sea salt, blood, speckles, unknown liquid and special oddities.
claims.span: Glue, Scotch Tape, 3D-black, Alien Secretion, Paint, Obscure Adhesive, Dark Grime, Sea Salt, Blood, Speckles, Unknown Liquid, Special Oddities
claims.epoch_note: User asked to list and show the types; order follows the Sets page.

claims.say: A Contamination Set covers any 3 of the 12 types, and a Contamination Hoard covers 6.
claims.epoch_note: EDITED: the user wrote 'any 3 Contaminated Cents' / '6 Contaminated Cents'. The requirement counts distinct TYPES, not Cents: three Cents all with Paint are not a Contamination Set.

claims.say: A Set that includes all 12 types is a Full Contamination Set, and only 7 can exist, as scotch tape is present on only 7 Cents.
claims.epoch_note: User's line, verbatim apart from joining the two clauses.

claims.say: The Chronicle Set consists of years whose meaning is essential to the project.
claims.why: User's line, verbatim. Says the years matter to the project; does not say Chang or the Council chose them for these meanings.

claims.say: 1971: the year US currency became fiat.
1979: the year the artist Rutherford Chang was born.
1982: the last year that pennies were struck in copper, and the last year of the collection.
claims.span: 1982 — "the last year cents were struck in copper"
claims.as_of: user's caption wording, 5 Sep 2026; catalogue: 867 Cents dated 1982, none later
claims.epoch_note: Copper was struck through 1982, so 'pre-1983' elsewhere.

claims.say: The Full Mint Set is determined by mint marks.
claims.span: holds at least one **S-mint**, one **D-mint**, and one Cent with **no mint

claims.say: An S for San Francisco, a D for Denver and no mint mark, usually Philadelphia, make a Full Mint Set, and only sixty Cents carry the S.
claims.as_of: cents-vision-guide.md; counts from September 2026 trait export, measured 2026-10-24
claims.epoch_note: EDITED: the user wrote D (Detroit). D is the Denver Mint. 'Usually' is right: some cents without a mark came from other mints.

claims.say: Decades Sets consist of every year of the given decade or decades that the collection holds.
claims.span: hold at least one Cent from **every mint year of that decade present in the collection**
claims.epoch_note: EDITED: added 'that the collection holds'. Without it the 1940s Set would ask for 1943, which the collection has none of.

claims.say: On cents.vision, you can find a Trait Atlas that defines each trait, as well as Collector Walls that show completed Sets, and many more features to explore the project.
claims.span: The codebook: how every trait is defined.
claims.epoch_note: User's close. Ends on an open invitation; no ending.
